subject: English
question_text: Complete the following text with right form of the verbs given in the box.
stimulus: earn read be consider go learn ride live acquire want Why do our parents (a) ----- us to (b) ----- to schools, colleges or universities? They want us to (c) ----- to read and to write and to (d) ----- knowledge so that we (e) ----- money and (f) -- --- comfortably as gentlemen. There (g) ----- a saying in our our country that whoever learns to (h) ----- and write (i) ----- in cars and on horses. In our country, a school, a college or a university traditionally (j) ----- to be a 'horse' of learning or knowledge.
guide_solution: Right form of verbs: (a) want; (b) go; (c) learn; (d) acquire; (e) can earn; (f) live; (g) is; (h) read; (i) rides; (j) considered.
